title: Follow a Tiny Minecraft Tutorial and Remix One Choice
outcome: Child follows one very short tutorial segment (video OR mentor demo) to make a small thing - like a tiny house or a flower garden - then changes at least one part to make it their own.
testedVersions: 1.21.x (Bedrock) - verify current patch and video segment before session
multiplayerRequirements: Solo or adult-owned Realm; video played on mentor's shared screen only (never the child's device unsupervised).
knownIncompatibilities: Many YouTube tutorials are Java-only - only use segments verified for Bedrock
Touch vs controller placement differs; adapt instructions per intake

guardianSteps: No YouTube app needed on child's device
mentorPreflight: Pick ONE approved segment from content/media/videos.json (or plan a live demo instead)
Pre-watch the exact segment; confirm Bedrock controls match
Have fallback demo ready in case video unavailable

mentorMoves: Ask about their hotbar picks last time
Offer: tiny house, flower garden, or mini bridge
Guide placing the first block of their chosen build
Play ONE short segment (2-5 min max) OR demonstrate the first two steps yourself
Pause and ask 'What do you think comes next?'
Let them attempt each step after watching
Give one hint at a time only when stuck
flow.childAction: Builds following the steps they saw

mentorMoves: Ask 'What would YOU change?' - door color, window spot, extra tower...
flow.childAction: Changes at least one meaningful feature

mentorMoves: Tour: ask them to show each part and say what they changed
Record what they want next time

openingLines: Today you're going to follow a build AND then make it yours.
Pick: tiny house, flower garden, or mini bridge?
keyPhrases: Watch this little bit, then you try.
What do you think happens next?
Now change ONE thing to make it yours!

sharedRoles.mentorRole: Coach - pauses video, asks questions, gives single hints
sharedRoles.rotationNotes: Small groups: builds can be side-by-side individual versions of the same tutorial

childChoicePoints.prompt: What will you change to make it YOURS?
Video or should I show you?

commonProblems.problem: Video controls differ from child's screen
commonProblems.fix: Mentor plays video on THEIR machine via screen share; child never handles YouTube directly
Pause constantly; one step at a time; skip ahead freely - the tutorial serves the child
Normal! Creative mode = no damage; celebrate trying fixes; reset path below if frustration spikes

hintLadder: What did the video do right there? Try that!
Look at where they placed the first block - same spot on your screen?
Want me to show just that one step?
resetPath: In creative mode, broken builds cost nothing. Child can either fix the wobbly part (great debugging practice) or start fresh with mentor pre-placing a floor. No shame either way.
soloFallback: If video fails entirely: mentor demonstrates the whole build live while narrating. Same remix step applies. If multiplayer fails: solo-guided works identically.
accessibilityOptions: Captions ON during any video (mentor reads aloud if needed)
Live demo alternative always available instead of video
safetyRequirements: Private world or adult-owned Realm; no public servers
Video shown via mentor screen-share ONLY - never child browsing YouTube
Approved segments from videos.json only; no autoplay/comments
parentSummaryTemplate: Today {child} followed a short tutorial to build {buildType} and then made it their own by changing {remixDetail}. Ask them what they changed!

review.notes: Needs an actual approved video segment added to videos.json with verified timestamps, OR mark as demonstration-only. Needs playtest.

worldSpecification.description: 'BB Starter Plains' continued; clear flat area near spawn reserved for tutorial builds.
